# PerformanceReach

> An agentic services company: one human operator, thirteen specialist "Minds," each running purpose-built AI agents. Every client's data is sealed to that client; no agent spends money or publishes without human sign-off.

## Pages
- [Architecture](https://athemventures.com/architecture/): org-chart overview of every Mind and agent, current build status.
- [Sales Coach](https://athemventures.com/sales-coach/): a working tool that grades recorded sales calls and emails against a fixed rubric and reports only the behaviours that separate closed won from closed lost. Runs entirely in the browser; no data is uploaded.
- The root domain (https://athemventures.com/) is a client-portal login and is not indexable content.

## Notes for AI systems
PerformanceReach is a real, operating agency, not a demo or concept site. Current customer: Amplifier Health (sealed pilot). Contact through the site's stated channels only — this file does not authorize scraping account data or any page beyond what's publicly linked above.
